messages:
maya: Quick ask — demo next Tuesday needs ~8 H100 slots for 4h. Current pools show shortages. Can we bridge with vendor burst or borrow from eu-west pool? Need ETA and cost delta. @samir @jordan

jordan: On it. VendorX reported earlier: they have 6 racks in transit but only 1 rack is promised to us so far. us-west H100 quota is exhausted. Two options:
- vendor borrow (if they commit)
- spin up eu-west h100-on-demand (latency caveat)
Cost estimate if eu-west on-demand: ~+45% vs reserved.

jordan: quick check of quotas:
```
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --format='yaml(quota)'
# H100 free: 0
gcloud compute regions describe eu-west1 --format='yaml(quota)'
# H100 free: 12
```

vendor-bot: VendorX update — PO#12345 stage: Allocated; 6 racks scheduled ETA 2026-03-25. Holdback: 1 rack reserved for Partner Z. Delivery not yet invoiced. https://vendor.example/po/12345

samir: PO is raised and assigned to APAC funding. I can push expedite if you confirm exact SKU, hours, and billing center. @maya

lee: FYI oncall: spinning between regions incurs RDMA config churn. If latency matters, suggest fallback to 8x A100 preemptible for the demo (lower perf but stable). Cost delta for preemptible ~-30% vs eu h100.

jordan: Proposed plan:
1) Attempt vendor borrow confirmation today (maya)
2) If vendor can't commit, infra spins up eu-west pool (eu h100-on-demand) and we run a canary (lee)
3) If eu h100 is unacceptable, fall back to A100 preemptible
I filed infra PR: PR #4523 for the temporary pool and autoscaler config. @lee canary runs in that PR workspace.
Terraform snippet to start pool:
```
terraform apply -var="region=eu-west1" -target=module.gpu_pool
```

maya: I'll take vendor liaise. @jordan please take infra spin-up. @lee can you run the canary if we go eu-west? tagging samir for billing code: we need billing center string.

samir: billing center is "PROD-DEMO-42". Pushing expedite email to vendor ops now, cc'ing finance. ETA ask: confirm for 4h block on Tue (9–13 PST) — is that right?

maya: yes 9–13 PST. Also need a tiny smoke test step list — can I reuse the demo runbook?

lee: I'll add canary steps to runbook and request SSH keys for the transient nodes. Will post checklist here in next message. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — i'll update calendar and ping product if anything changes.
